Use the future continuousform to describe actions in progress at a specific time in thefuture
Where will you be studying next year?
I'll be studying in Paris. I won't be working as a journalist then.
Use the future with will verbs that are not usually used in the continuous form.
What will you achieve in twenty years? Will you be financially independent?
Yes, I will.But I'll have to work really hard.
